items.information:
Join us for an FMC mean enroute to WCCT Berkeley! Please note that this competition will **not** hold 3x3 Speedsolve and is not recommended for new competitors.

This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [Speedcubeshop](https://speedcubeshop.com/).
